messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Let me think about how to compose this scene.

Key elements needed:
1. A bicycle - two wheels, frame, handlebars, seat, pedals
2. A pelican sitting on the seat - body, head, large distinctive beak with pouch, wings, legs

Approach options:
- Pure geometric shapes (circles, ellipses, paths) - clean and reliable
- Too much detail could become messy

I'll narrow to: wheels as circles with spokes, diamond frame with lines/paths, pelican as a stylized bird body with a long orange beak and pouch, wings on handlebars, legs reaching to pedals. Use a soft pastel palette with some sky background.

Let me draft the layout on a 600x400 canvas:
- Rear wheel center ~ (170, 300), radius 70
- Front wheel center ~ (430, 300), radius 70
- Frame: seat tube, down tube, top tube, head tube, fork
- Seat around (210, 190)
- Handlebar around (400, 170)
- Pelican body above seat, head with long beak pointing forward

For the pelican: body ellipse, head circle, big beak path (orange), pouch below beak, eye, wing as curved path extending to handlebar, legs to pedals.

I'll write a clean, well-commented SVG. Keep it readable and visually appealing. Add ground line and maybe sun for charm.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400" width="600" height="400">
  <!-- Sky background -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bfe3ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#eaf6ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a8d08d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7ab55c"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="600" height="400" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <rect y="350" width="600" height="50" fill="url(#ground)"/>
  <circle cx="500" cy="70" r="30" fill="#ffe28a"/>

  <!-- Sun rays -->
  <g stroke="#ffd970" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="500" y1="25" x2="500" y2="10"/>
    <line x1="500" y1="115" x2="500" y2="130"/>
    <line x1="545" y1="70" x2="560" y2="70"/>
    <line x1="455" y1="70" x2="440" y2="70"/>
    <line x1="535" y1="35" x2="545" y2="25"/>
    <line x1="465" y1="105" x2="455" y2="115"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Ground line -->
  <line x1="0" y1="350" x2="600" y2="350" stroke="#5f8f46" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Bicycle -->
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Wheels -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6">
      <circle cx="170" cy="300" r="65"/>
      <circle cx="430" cy="300" r="65"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3">
      <circle cx="170" cy="300" r="60"/>
      <circle cx="430" cy="300" r="60"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Spokes -->
    <g stroke="#999" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="110" y1="300" x2="230" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="170" y1="240" x2="170" y2="360"/>
      <line x1="128" y1="258" x2="212" y2="342"/>
      <line x1="128" y1="342" x2="212" y2="258"/>
      <line x1="370" y1="300" x2="490" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="430" y1="240" x2="430" y2="360"/>
      <line x1="388" y1="258" x2="472" y2="342"/>
      <line x1="388" y1="342" x2="472" y2="258"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Hubs -->
    <circle cx="170" cy="300" r="8" fill="#333"/>
    <circle cx="430" cy="300" r="8" fill="#333"/>

    <!-- Frame -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#d23f3f" stroke-width="8">
      <line x1="170" y1="300" x2="240" y2="220"/>  <!-- seat stay -->
      <line x1="240" y1="220" x2="240" y2="190"/>  <!-- seat tube -->
      <line x1="170" y1="300" x2="290" y2="300"/>  <!-- chain stay -->
      <line x1="240" y1="220" x2="290" y2="300"/>  <!-- down tube -->
      <line x1="290" y1="300" x2="395" y2="200"/>  <!-- down tube to head -->
      <line x1="240" y1="190" x2="395" y2="185"/>  <!-- top tube -->
      <line x1="395" y1="185" x2="430" y2="300"/>  <!-- fork -->
    </g>

    <!-- Chainring & crank -->
    <circle cx="290" cy="300" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="290" y1="300" x2="270" y2="330" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5"/>
    <rect x="258" y="328" width="22" height="6" fill="#222" rx="2"/>

    <!-- Handlebar -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="6">
      <path d="M395 185 L410 160 Q430 150 445 165"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Seat -->
    <path d="M215 190 Q240 178 265 190 Q240 196 215 190 Z" fill="#333"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pelican -->
  <g>
    <!-- Tail feathers -->
    <path d="M195 175 Q170 165 165 185 Q180 190 195 185 Z" fill="#8b9dc4"/>
    <!-- Legs to pedal -->
    <g stroke="#f4a261" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path d="M245 215 Q240 260 265 320"/>
      <path d="M245 215 Q255 260 250 310"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="245" cy="185" rx="42" ry="32" fill="#f4f7fb" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Wing reaching to handlebar -->
    <path d="M250 175 Q310 170 405 165 Q390 195 305 200 Q275 200 250 188 Z"
          fill="#8b9dc4" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M275 185 Q330 190 385 180" fill="none" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M285 195 Q340 200 375 190" fill="none" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Neck -->
    <path d="M270 165 Q300 150 310 120 Q315 95 340 95" fill="none" stroke="#f4f7fb" stroke-width="22"/>
    <path d="M260 168 Q290 155 300 122 Q305 92 335 90" fill="none" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M280 165 Q310 150 320 118 Q325 92 348 95" fill="none" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx="345" cy="95" r="22" fill="#f4f7fb" stroke="#5b6c8c" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Crest tuft -->
    <path d="M335 75 Q330 60 345 65 Q340 70 350 72 Z" fill="#5b6c8c"/>
    <!-- Beak upper -->
    <path d="M362 88 Q415 85 465 95 Q415 100 362 102 Z" fill="#f28c28" stroke="#c96b15" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Pouch (lower beak) -->
    <path d="M362 102 Q415 130 460 100 Q415 108 362 102 Z" fill="#ffa94d" stroke="#c96b15" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx="348" cy="90" r="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="90" r="2.5" fill="#222"/>
    <!-- Cheek blush -->
    <circle cx="340" cy="100" r="4" fill="#ffc9c9" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- Feet on pedal -->
    <path d="M255 318 Q270 318 275 324 Q260 328 250 324 Z" fill="#f4a261"/>
    <path d="M245 308 Q258 308 262 314 Q248 318 240 314 Z" fill="#f4a261"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <g stroke="#8b9dc4" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8">
    <line x1="60" y1="180" x2="110" y2="180"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="220" x2="100" y2="220"/>
    <line x1="70" y1="260" x2="120" y2="260"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

A pelican in mid-ride — notice the iconic pouchy beak pointing forward, the wing gripping the handlebar, and the webbed feet on the pedal. Save the snippet as `pelican.svg` and open it in any browser. Want me to tweak the color palette, add a helmet, or animate the wheels?
